text: sorry, are u saying the v4 and the v5 are both being loaded at the same time? or what? why would the v4 be relevant if the v5 passes ?
resolution: Clarified that Compact Car has one on-disk RJMD v4, not simultaneous v4/v5 loads. V5 is the current target and exists on other catalog documents; the Compact Car failure is a TypeScript compatibility validator rejecting a v4 edge-semantic row against a v5-only logical-vertex table, while the native v4 envelope reader succeeds. No fallback is being treated as valid.
